title: Clinical Evaluation of Automatic Coronary Artery Disease Reporting and Data System (CAD-RADS TM) in Coronary CT Angiography Using Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: A CNN-based system assigns CAD-RADS categories on coronary CT angiography and is clinically validated against readers and invasive angiography.
ai_technology: Prospective validation includes 346 patients; reported CAD sensitivity/specificity/accuracy are compared with reader performance.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
